title: Infracost (YC W21) Is Hiring Sr Dev Advocate to make agents cloud cost-aware
summary: Infracost, a Y Combinator W21 company, is hiring a Senior Developer Advocate to help make AI agents cloud cost-aware. This role focuses on bridging the gap between AI agent capabilities and cloud infrastructure cost management, enabling developers to build more cost-efficient solutions.
problem_solved: Addresses the challenge of AI agents automatically generating cloud infrastructure without visibility into cost implications.
why_valuable: As AI coding agents proliferate, ensuring they understand cloud costs prevents expensive infrastructure mistakes and promotes responsible cloud usage.
